categorical_claims.representation: Family I K := I -> K, with existing Coord and declarations; no semantic type redesign
categorical_claims.reads: pullback f v = v composed with f, contravariant
categorical_claims.writes: pushforward d v i = finite sum over all occurrence tags whose destination equals i, covariant
categorical_claims.laws: Generic identity/composition, zero/add preservation (pushforwardHom), occurrence equivalence invariance, finite sigma grouping
categorical_claims.program_use: Program.collect directly calls generic pushforward for each defined tensor; the category organization is not an unused sidecar
categorical_claims.algebra: AddCommMonoid only on each participating defined carrier; body ScalarOps remain explicit data; no multiplication laws or Float algebra instances
categorical_claims.nonlinearity: No primitive homomorphism across sums; reciprocal-before sum is 3/4 versus reciprocal-after sum 1/6
categorical_claims.alignment_reference: papers/NaperianTyping.md, Fiber semantics and reindexing; Reformulated view: Naperian D-graded PROPs
categorical_claims.alignment: Contravariant reads are precomposition of plain function families. Representability of lifted objects is a separate assumption from strong monoidality and coherence, not a consequence established by this prototype.
categorical_claims.limit: No full Cat/Functor/Kan-extension, D-graded PROP integration, representability/coherence derivation, or full categorical semantic interpretation claimed. General categorical integration remains deferred.

model_claims.roles: input Bool partitions finite declared tensor identifiers; defined is the false subtype; output proof requires false input
model_claims.tags: Finite per-target statement identifier and guard-admitted valuation subtype; duplicates remain separate sigma tags
model_claims.destinations: Already bounded Coord values targeting defined tensors only; noninjective maps permitted
model_claims.input_presence: Dependent optional complete tensor families; isSome exactly equals input role even for zero-coordinate tensors
model_claims.extra_identifiers: InputBinding is indexed only by declared identifiers; undeclared extras are structurally unrepresentable, not runtime rejection. Bindings for declared defined identifiers are rejected by ValidInput.
model_claims.admissibility: Every admitted occurrence body must be some, including active zero-valued and non-output bodies; excluded valuations have no occurrence
model_claims.collection: All tagged fiber values summed; empty fiber zero; candidate prior target value not included unless body reads it
model_claims.models: Admissibility, input agreement and every defined coordinate equation, not outputs alone
model_claims.equation_operator: Domain AdmEnv, retains candidate inputs and replaces defined tensors by collection; result has type Store, not admissible subtype
model_claims.fixedpoint: Models iff input agreement and existence of an admissibility witness whose equation operator fixes the store
model_claims.functional_meaning: AdmInput means existence of exactly one complete model; output projection uses Classical.choose, not a solver or constructive execution claim
